apps.localizedDescription: Native download manager with a persistent queue, background transfers, pause/resume, in-app browser, file previews, Files access, and Lock Screen / Dynamic Island Live Activities. iOS controls background progress refreshes. Resume support depends on the server. Requires iOS 18 or later.
